tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: The page: paper by day, night in the dark theme. Everything sits on it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, inputs, code blocks: a step up from the ground, set apart by a hairline, never a shadow.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text, headings and icons on ground and surface (16:1 and up in both themes).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on ground and surface: captions, help, metadata (6:1 and up).

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines between sections and around surfaces. Decorative only: never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Control boundaries: inputs, secondary buttons, chips (3.3:1 and up on ground and surface).

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: The brand's orange: the p of the mark, primary buttons, highlights. Never text, focus ring or input border on ground (2.5:1 on paper).

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text and icons on signal (6.6:1). White on signal is 2.8:1 and is never used.

tokens.name: signal-text
tokens.usage: Orange text and links on ground and surface (4.7:1 on paper, 5.3:1 on white, 8:1 on night).

tokens.name: mark-window
tokens.usage: The mark's window, in every theme.

tokens.name: mark-pupil
tokens.usage: The mark's pupil and its tick, in every theme.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The focus ring, drawn outside a gap of ground (see shadow focus-ring), so it always sits on ground at 16:1.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text and icons on ground and surface (4.7:1 and up). Always with a word or a tick, never colour alone.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions on ground and surface (5.8:1 and up). Always with a word, never colour alone.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: One per page: the landing headline.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Page titles in docs and Studio.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Polyxd is an open format for interfaces.
styles.usage: The paragraph under a display line.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Your app draws it in its own design system.
styles.usage: Running text. Keep lines near 65 characters.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Captions, help text, metadata, in muted.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows and small labels, uppercase, in muted.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips; between related controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between a label and its field.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones; the default gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; between fields.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between groups.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between sections on a page.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Page gutters on desktop.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Between landing sections.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips and inputs: fully round ends, like the p's stem.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, dialogs. Drawn as the mark's squircle where supported (corner-shape: squircle).

tokens.name: radius-small
tokens.usage: Code blocks, menus, small surfaces.

tokens.name: radius-icon
tokens.usage: The app icon's corner, as a share of its side.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every control: a gap of ground, then a 2px ring in focus. Solid, never orange.

tokens.name: none
tokens.usage: Surfaces carry no shadow: a hairline in rule sets them apart.

timing.note: The mark's and the interface's motion. Nothing bounces; respect prefers-reduced-motion.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Every transition, including the pupil moving between states.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, press, small state changes.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: The pupil between states; panels opening.

tokens.name: duration-blink
tokens.usage: One blink of the mark.

tokens.name: duration-orbit
tokens.usage: One turn of the pupil while thinking.
